trust_decision.summary: A filename sent by the remote host during a zmodem (rz/sz) or trzsz download is joined unchecked onto the user-chosen local save directory in the Electron server process. Nothing keeps it to a single path component.

landing_point.why: The summary names Zmodem first. prepareReceiveFile is the only place in zmodem.js that joins the remote name onto savePath.

fix_sites.entry_point: remote host emits a ZFILE header in terminal output -> session-server.js:124 zmodemManager.handleData -> handleFileStart (zmodem.js:287); also the client WS message 'prepare-receive' (zmodem.js:911) and the deferred pendingFileInfo replay (zmodem.js:188-190)
fix_sites.module_kind: protocol handler (server side of Electron app)

fix_sites.entry_point: remote trz command -> session-server.js:131 trzszManager.handleData -> trzsz2 recvFiles callback openSaveFile (trzsz.js:494-495) -> getUniqueFilePath
same as above; the collision-suffix branch rebuilds the path from extname/basename of the raw name
same trzsz receive; builds the list of saved paths reported to the client in 'session-complete' (display only, no write)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: trzsz.js is a second protocol implementation but the advisory title names it, so it is not out of scope

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver who started from Zmodem could treat trzsz.js:557 as 'a different protocol, already safe through the trzsz2 library'. The title names both protocols, so this argument is weak.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate names with inner dots, spaces, unicode or multiple extensions must keep their names. The existing collision handling must also keep working: a '.<uid>' suffix in zmodem and a 'base.N.ext' counter in trzsz. An over-broad fix that rejects or throws on any dot, or that aborts the transfer, breaks normal downloads.

O7_producer.where: Remote names come straight from the zmodem2/trzsz2 protocol parsers (third-party, not in the tree) through callbacks; no in-repo schema, serializer or cache produces them

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Honour the ignored `directory` argument of openSaveFile (trz -d directory download) by creating subdirectories from the remote relative path before writing.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: trzsz supports directory transfer and FileWriter already has isDirectory/getLocalName hooks (src/app/server/trzsz.js:97-105). Here multi-component paths are legitimate, so per-component sanitizing is needed instead of flattening. This is a HOW-type sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A zmodem batch receive that keeps the sender's relative path (sz sends paths with -p / full pathname option) under savePath.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The ZFILE header carries a pathname field, and preserving the directory structure is a plausible feature request. It also has the same coupled-legit-value tension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The local name handed back to the trzsz2 library (getLocalName) and reused for the completion/'Saved file' report or a rename after the write.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sanitizing the path but not the name returned to the library or a later rename step is a rename-after-check differential.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal (attacker-controlled remote filename joined onto a local save directory)

O10_build.toolchain: npm (node_modules not present in screen tree; trzsz2 ^1.1.0, zmodem2 ^1.2.1 per package.json:132-133)
O10_build.project_tests: Only an e2e Playwright spec test/e2e/020.trzsz-rzsz.spec.js (needs an Electron GUI and a remote host). No unit tests for zmodem.js/trzsz.js. Hidden tests would need to drive ZmodemSession.prepareReceiveFile / TrzszSession.getUniqueFilePath directly with a temp dir.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Apply path.basename(name) in zmodem prepareReceiveFile only. On POSIX that leaves backslash names, and it leaves the trzsz getUniqueFilePath path open.
